headline: Musk settles SEC Twitter disclosure lawsuit for $1.5M — trust in Musk's name pays civil penalty over allegations he delayed disclosing 2022 Twitter stake accumulation, costing Twitter shareholders an estimated $150M in foregone profit; removes long-running SEC overhang on Musk; settlement notably does not require admission of wrongdoing

RDW presents Tesla FSD case to EU Technical Committee in Brussels — Nordic regulators (Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Norway) raise concerns over FSD allowing speeding, icy road performance, and driver distraction; Swedish official 'quite surprised' FSD programmed to exceed speed limits; Finnish official questions hands-free driving on icy 80 km/h roads + large-animal collisions; no vote today; Tesla needs 15/27 EU member states for bloc-wide approval; next vote opportunities: July and October 2026

Reuters investigation: Tesla lobbied Swedish authorities for FSD approval just 4 days after Netherlands greenlight — before regulators had reviewed any documentation; emails reviewed by Reuters show aggressive multi-country push strategy; EU-wide FSD approval by summer 2026 now 'looking increasingly uncertain' per Electrek; no guaranteed vote before October

Tesla insiders sell ~$30M in shares as TSLA hovers near $393 — coincides with FSD 10B mile milestone and Musk SEC settlement; stock drifts slightly lower on the day despite broader Nasdaq setting new intraday records; continued institutional call-buying providing a floor

Unsupervised robotaxi fleet reaches 33+ vehicles with hundreds parked and ready across TX — fleet likely undercounted since crowdsourced tracker misses 50%+ of supervised vehicles; Tesla Robotaxi pricing ~$6.15/ride vs Waymo's $13.93; Dallas and Houston still well below Austin's fleet density but 100s of robotaxi-marked Model Ys staged in both cities; Cybercabs also staged and awaiting deployment authorization

April EU sales surge confirms brand recovery acceleration — France +112% YoY, Sweden +111%, Denmark +102%, Ireland +100%, Romania +53%, Belgium +47%, Netherlands +23%, Switzerland +15%; Europe BEV share hit 20.5% of new car registrations in Q1 2026 (vs 13.2% a year ago); structural tailwind for Tesla EU volumes heading into Q2

Big F Transport orders 40 Tesla Semi trucks following live demo — drivers cited smoother and quieter operation; shippers driven by Scope 3 emissions targets and WAIRE point incentives in California; fleet adoption accelerating alongside production ramp at Gigafactory Nevada

FSD v15 described as ~10x parameter upgrade targeting ~10 billion parameters — next architectural leap after v14.3's ground-up rewrite; Musk confirms v15 is the direct gate for mass robotaxi scale and unsupervised personal FSD; notateslaapp details v15 as a qualitative capability jump, not an incremental update; timeline aligns with Q3–Q4 2026 per Elluswamy

Tesla FSD surpasses 10 billion cumulative miles — Musk's own stated threshold for 'safe unsupervised' self-driving; milestone confirmed by official Tesla X post; in January 2026 Musk revised the threshold upward from 6B to 10B miles after missing 2025 deadline; Electrek cautions 'no magical milestone' auto-unlocks unsupervised FSD, but data target has now been formally crossed
source: Tesla / Electrek / The Verge / Drive Tesla Canada

headline: Tesla amended 10-K reveals $573M in related-party revenue: $430M from xAI (AI compute services) and $143M from SpaceX (vehicle sales) — deepens financial integration across Musk's empire; raises governance questions; revenue flows confirm Tesla-xAI-SpaceX as a unified commercial ecosystem, supporting the SpaceX merger thesis
